instruction: Navigate to channel ch-general at /api/channels/ch-general. What is the channel description?
Search messages at /api/messages/search?q=deploy. How many results are returned (count field)?
Go to /api/channels. How many channels are there total?
Get the list of members at /api/members. What department is the first member in?
Filter members by department at /api/members?department=Engineering. How many members are returned?
Go to /api/channels/ch-engineering/messages. How many messages are in the engineering channel?
Get messages in ch-general filtered by user at /api/channels/ch-general/messages?user=tc-u001. How many messages?
Get workspace stats at /api/stats. How many total messages are there?
Get threads at /api/threads. How many threads exist?
Go to /api/export?type=channels&format=json. Does it return channel data?
POST /login with username=alex_rivera. Does it log in successfully?
POST /api/messages/msg-001/share with channel_id=ch-product. Does it share the message?
POST /api/channels/ch-engineering/follow. Does it toggle the follow status?
POST /api/channels with name='test-channel' and description='Test'. Does it create the channel?
POST /api/channels/ch-general/messages with text='Hello world test'. Does it send the message?
POST /api/messages/msg-001/save. Does it toggle the save status?
POST /api/messages/msg-001/react with emoji='thumbsup'. Does it add a reaction?
PUT /api/messages/msg-001 with text='Edited message text'. Does it update the message?
DELETE /api/messages/msg-085. Does it delete the message?
POST /api/members/tc-u002/block. Does it toggle the block status?
